text: Based on the evidence presented, the cafeteria should consider introducing the plant-based menu for several reasons. Firstly, the plant-based menu meets every nutritional requirement and provides a fresh, wholesome option for students. Secondly, the live fermentation station and seasonal produce contract savings would ensure that the new menu is not only fresh but also cost-effective. Lastly, the fact that the cafeteria was able to maintain steady demand after introducing the new menu is a strong indicator that the new menu was well received and popular among students.
